text:
maria-finance: FYI: NL tax office just rejected our OSS registration for reseller_x (EU OSS). Need billing + legal input before the next invoice cycle.

oliver-legal: Can you paste the rejection text? Was it about VAT ID mismatch or representation?

maria-finance: Here’s the notice we got from the Belastingdienst:
```
Rejection notice:
'OSS registration declined: non‑EU intermediary must provide EU fiscal representative or use non‑Union OSS via Netherlands not accepted.'
Ref: NL-Tax ref 2026/OSS/4478
```

tia-tax-consult: This is pretty common. Short options: 1) reseller secures an EU fiscal rep (preferred); 2) reseller registers OSS in a member state that accepts non-union OSS (rare); 3) revert to country-by-country VAT treatment for B2C sales. Interim recommendation: pause OSS billing for this account and treat transactions as non-OSS until rep confirmed. :memo:

sam-ops: Operational question — do we hold invoices or issue with a "VAT pending" flag? We need a clear signal to the invoicing pipeline.

maria-finance: Proposed immediate steps: freeze automatic OSS invoices for reseller_x; emit pro-forma invoices only for reconciliation; set tax_code = "pending_fiscal_rep" in billing config so the pipeline skips OSS rules. Any objections?

oliver-legal: No objection to pausing. Also request written confirmation from reseller about timeline for getting a fiscal rep + an indemnity clause for any retro VAT liabilities they claim. Legal to review their POA when provided.

tia-tax-consult: I’ll draft the email and checklist for the fiscal representative requirements (POA, rep contact details, expected timeline, evidence of registration). Will cc legal. ETA 24h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

billing-bot: Billing rule update: tax_override 'pending_fiscal_rep' applied to account reseller_x. Next invoice run will respect override.

maria-finance: Thanks — I'll pause invoices and wait for tia's draft. @andrew-partner-ops please hold any retries for this account. :raised_hands:
